description: This Java source file defines the utility class DistPubSubAccess for interacting with Akka's DistributedPubSubMediator within an Eclipse Ditto project. It provides static methods for publishing, subscribing, unsubscribing, and messaging actors over distributed pub/sub channels, including group topics. The class encapsulates the creation of messages used to communicate with the Akka actor system for cluster messaging tasks.

classes.name: DistPubSubAccess
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods to facilitate interaction with Akka's DistributedPubSubMediator messages such as publishing, subscribing, unsubscribing, and sending messages in a distributed cluster environment.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Creates a publish message to send a message to all subscribers of a given topic.

methods.name: publishViaGroup
methods.description: Creates a publish message targeting a group subscriber for a given topic with a suffix to indicate grouping.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscription message for an ActorRef to a specific topic.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Creates an unsubscription message for an ActorRef from a specific topic.

methods.name: subscribeViaGroup
methods.description: Creates a subscription message for an ActorRef to a grouped topic with an associated group name.

methods.name: unsubscribeViaGroup
methods.description: Creates an unsubscription message from a grouped topic for an ActorRef.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Registers an ActorRef on the distributed pub/sub system for message delivery.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Creates a message to send to a specific ActorRef identified by a path.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Creates a message to send to a specific ActorRef with an option for local affinity.

methods.name: sendToAll
methods.description: Creates a message to send to all ActorRefs at a specified path.

methods.name: sendToAll
methods.description: Creates a message to send to all ActorRefs at a specified path, with control over whether to include self.
